The study day variable --ENDY describes the relative day of the observation starting with the reference date as Day 1. They are determined by comparing the date portion of the respective date/time variable --ENDTC to the date portion of the Subject Reference Start Date (RFSTDTC from DM). If --ENDTC or RFSTDTC date is incomplete, --ENDY is null.

EPOCH is assigned from SE using SESTDTC and SEENDTC dates as follows: If --DTC / --STDTC is present for a domain and on/before SEENDTC date or SEENDTC is blank for the screening EPOCH then assign as “SCREENING”. Else if only --ENDTC is present for a domain and on/after SESTDTC date or SEENDTC is blank and before SEENDTC date for the screening EPOCH then assign as “SCREENING”. Note: If only month and year present or only year present for --STDTC, --ENDTC or --DTC but month and year or year only respectively are prior to SEENDTC for screening EPOCH then assign as "SCREENING" If --DTC / --STDTC is present for a domain on/after SESTDTC and on/before SEENDTC date or SEENDTC is blank for the treatment EPOCH then assign as “TREATMENT”. Else if only --ENDTC is present for a domain and on/after SESTDTC date and on/before SEENDTC date or SEENDTC is blank for the treatment EPOCH then assign as “TREATMENT”. Note: If only month and year present or only year present for --STDTC, --ENDTC or --DTC but month and year or year only respectively are both after SESTDTC and prior to SEENDTC for treatment EPOCH then assign as "TREATMENT" If --DTC / --STDTC is present for a domain after SESTDTC date and on/before SEENDTC date or SEENDTC is blank for the follow-up EPOCH then assign as “FOLLOW-UP”. Else if only �"ENDTC is present for a domain and after SESTDTC date and on/before SEENDTC date or SEENDTC is blank for the follow-up EPOCH then assign as “FOLLOW-UP”. Note: If only month and year present or only year present for --STDTC, --ENDTC or --DTC but month and year or year only respectively are after to SESTDTC for follow-up EPOCH then assign as "FOLLOW-UP"
Note: For DV domain only DVSTDTC should be used to assign EPOCH not DVDTC
If --STDTC, --ENDTC or --DTC are partial: If day is blank but month and year are present and the month and year then for -STDTC and --DTC items assume a start day of 01 and for --ENDTC assume an end day of the last day of the month, if both day and month are blank then for for -STDTC and --DTC items assume a start day/month of 01JAN and for --ENDTC assume an end day/month of 31DEC
If all dates prior to informed consent (SESTDTC date for the screening EPOCH) and applying partial date rules as above: If domain has --DTC item and --DTC item is populated, even if -STDTC or -ENDTC items present and prior to informed consent, and --DTC is not prior to date of informed consent then set EPOCH to corresponding rules above for --DTC date Else if domain has --DTC item and --DTC item is populated and is prior to date of informed consent then set EPOCH to blank and output PXL warning to log Else if domain has --STDTC only and (no --DTC or --ENDTC items or --DTC is blank if item present) and if --STDTC is prior to date of informed consent then set EPOCH to blank and output PXL warning to log Else if domain has an --ENDTC item and (no --DTC item or --DTC item is blank if present) and if --ENDTC is both populated and prior to date of informed consent then set EPOCH to blank and output PXL warning to log
